title: Algebraic inverse image and coefficient map for a composite
statement: For three independently sized sites essentially small in the coefficient universe, finite-limit-preserving set-sheaf functors F and G, algebraic inverse-image lifts I from R to RI and I' from S to SI [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image], and coefficient maps RI to S and SI to T, there exist a ring sheaf RI', an algebraic inverse-image lift for F composed with G, and a coefficient map RI' to T. Its underlying structural map is G applied to the first underlying structural map, followed by the second.

source.place: Tags 03D7 and 0D6D, algebraic inverse image and composition.

proof.text: Construct the transported commutative ring object by the finite-product monoidal functor; reconstruct its presheaf of rings on sections. The small-model equivalence reflects the sheaf condition. Transport additive groups and scalar actions to construct the algebraic inverse-image module functor, with every graph equation checked by finite-product comparisons.

Compose the underlying coefficient maps. Their addition, multiplication and one graph equations compose because G preserves the diagrams. Cancel the underlying ring isomorphism and test universal binary graphs and the constant-one graph to bundle a ring-sheaf morphism. Its underlying map has the required equality.

lean.statement:
theorem compositeAlgebraicImage_exists
    (F : Sheaf J (Type w) ⥤ Sheaf K (Type w))
    (G : Sheaf K (Type w) ⥤ Sheaf H (Type w))
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteLimits G]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w}) (S RI : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{w})
    (T SI : Sheaf H CommRingCat.{w})
    (I : AlgebraicInverseImage F R RI) (c : RI ⟶ S)
    (I' : AlgebraicInverseImage G S SI) (c' : SI ⟶ T) :
    ∃ (RI' : Sheaf H CommRingCat.{w})
      (I'' : AlgebraicInverseImage (F ⋙ G) R RI') (d : RI' ⟶ T),
      I''.ringUnderlying.hom ≫
        (sheafCompose H (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{w})).map d =
      G.map (I.ringUnderlying.hom ≫
        (sheafCompose K (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{w})).map c) ≫
      I'.ringUnderlying.hom ≫
        (sheafCompose H (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{w})).map c'
